module_summary: Gshare branch predictor: a 7-bit global history XOR PC indexes a 128-entry table of 2-bit saturating counters, with separate predict and train ports.

anchors.name: pht
anchors.why: 128-entry pattern history table of 2-bit saturating counters.

anchors.name: predict_history_r
anchors.why: Global history register: shifts predictions, restored on misprediction.

anchors.name: predict_index
anchors.why: History XOR predict_pc hash; read index into PHT.

anchors.name: train_index
anchors.why: train_history XOR train_pc hash; PHT entry updated on training.

anchors.name: predict_taken
anchors.why: Prediction: MSB of indexed PHT counter, valid with predict_valid.

anchors.name: predict_valid
anchors.why: Prediction request; enables history shift and qualifies outputs.

anchors.name: train_valid
anchors.why: Training request; enables PHT counter update and history recovery.

anchors.name: train_mispredicted
anchors.why: Triggers history rollback, taking precedence over prediction shift.

anchors.name: train_taken
anchors.why: Actual outcome: increments/decrements counter, appended to restored history.

anchors.name: predict_history
anchors.why: History snapshot used for the prediction, returned to requester.

anchors.name: predict_pc
anchors.why: Fetch PC hashed into prediction index.

anchors.name: train_pc
anchors.why: Branch PC hashed into training index.

anchors.name: train_history
anchors.why: History checkpoint for training index and misprediction recovery.

groups.name: pattern_history_table
groups.description: 2-bit saturating counter table updated by training.

groups.name: global_history
groups.description: History shift register with misprediction recovery.

groups.name: predict_lookup
groups.description: Gshare hash and PHT read producing predicted direction.
